_meta.description: Transparent inputs for Paper F combined-intervention portfolio model. Every parameter carries value, uncertainty, source, evidence grade, and verification status. Effect sizes are all-cause relative mortality (rate/hazard ratio) among the population REACHED; coverage is the reachable/eligible fraction of the high-vulnerability (SVI Q4) population. Density-type interventions use coverage=1.0 with rr as the population effect of the stated increment.
_meta.status_legend: verified = citation checked this build; provisional = defensible published value, to be finalized in literature-review + citation-management phase
_meta.gap_source: CDC WONDER age-adjusted all-cause mortality by CDC SVI quartile; county_disparity_results.csv

interventions.name: Medicaid expansion
interventions.source: Miller Johnson Wherry 2021 QJE; Lee 2022 Lancet Public Health; Sommers 2017 NEJM
interventions.note: This corpus's own Callaway-Sant'Anna DiD implied RR 0.988 (~null); synthesis uses published protective estimates with wide CI to reflect tension.

interventions.name: Community health workers
interventions.source: Kangovi 2018 JAMA IM RCT (PMID 30422224); Vasan 2020 Health Serv Res pooled (PMID 32643163)
interventions.note: Demonstrated effect is reduced hospitalization (pooled IRR 0.66); the mortality rr is literature-synthesized, not a direct trial endpoint. Effect among high-risk reached subset.

interventions.name: Integrated behavioral health

interventions.name: Physician workforce (+10 PCP/100k)

diminishing_returns_lambda.note: Overlap/diminishing-returns penalty on combined log relative-risk; interventions act on overlapping people and shared pathways.
